message: The "S" prefix is being used with a <chip />, try using it with a <switch /> or <pushbutton />
reason: Manufacturer part is a mechanical SPDT switch. SW1 is appropriate. Official importer emits a chip solely for complete supplier pin coverage; inspected core check tests primitive category/prefix, not electrical connectivity.

message: All pins on SW1 are underspecified (no pinAttributes set)
reason: All three manufacturer terminals are passive bidirectional contacts. Their common/throw roles and 2-3 / OPEN / 2-1 function were checked against manufacturer tables. No powered IC pin is omitted. Inspected checks code warns for every simple_chip with no pinAttributes regardless of physical device type.

message: SW1 has no pin with requires_power=true
reason: This passive three-terminal mechanical switch needs no dedicated supply terminal. Pin 2 carries PWM; falsely declaring it a required power pin would be incorrect. Inspected check applies powered-chip assumptions to supplier box imports.

message: SW1 has no pin with requires_ground=true
reason: The mechanical switch has no ground terminal. Both throws are signal contacts; the H-bridge provides their input bias. Inspected check applies powered-chip assumptions to all simple_chip components.
